notes.title: Cemetery Level is now available, Patch notes and game release
notes.notes:
Hi All,

We are happy to announce that Cemetery Level is now available, also uploaded a game play demo for this level in the store page, below are some screenshots and direct YT link for the gameplay demo:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22533147/3cb9834c6dfe3a75cde13e5192751914637a150c.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22533147/eb6db2004d49180a3a1471c265541fae95e2f568.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22533147/4dcd0186b730cff85fdd1c0acef80d1eaa2264fd.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22533147/8957db0c2b171ac829ebe13ea1a7b2a817603822.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22533147/4559be95cc5f7de788dc653e1aac1d323fca790b.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22533147/d7d6e849174d36da43c4b5fb6c29dcf3eb55c811.jpg

Gameplay Demo:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rQUOR5rghv8

Patch Notes

1. Various minor fixes and tweaks.

2. Moved Boss Health to be under Level Timer at the top center of the screen, this gives better tracking to player for boss health instead of placing it above boss head as the boss moves alot around the screen and sometimes health bar gets out of screen bounds.

3. Added Warzone and Cemetery Player(s) characters to level designer reset templates inside right click context menu for Player(s) objects.

Game Release

We would like to thank everyone for their support during early access launch, we will be releasing the game tomorrow and we are hoping for the best, thank you all again and see you on the other side with more levels and contents. 

Thanks

notes.title: Update v1.0 Released
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

We have released a big update today, this update paves the way before transitioning from Early Access to full release, release notes:

1. Although you can change and play your own music, but we changed the default music for most levels, this resulted into updating and uploading all affected level files along with their Level Designer project files, that explains the size of this update. 

2. Added support to add sound effect for shooting transition for enemies and boss in Level Designer, this also paves the way for Cemetery level as some enemies use this feature.

3. Fixed minor issue with HitBox Selection using Right Mouse Button in Level Designer.

4. Updated UserManual to reflect latest updates and changes.

5. Tweaked enemy shooting range in game, earlier the enemy will suppress firing its weapon if the spacing between it and left side of screen is approx 200 pixels (depends on resolution), this created a problem for big enemies who occupy alot of space on screen, thus they would fire their weapons much less, this has been corrected.

6. Changed Stats names when viewing stats by removing "Number Of" text before each stat.

7. Game Version is now 1.0 which will be the version for release after integrating Cemetery Level which is expected to be done early next week.

Thanks

notes.title: Update v0.05 is live introducing Game Menu Themes
notes.notes:
Hi All,

We got a lot of positive feedback on how the game launcher themes are cool, so we thought, what would be more cool than expanding this feature to Game Main Menus, we are happy to introduce the same themes feature in game launcher for game menus but those themes will be animated instead of static images, you will find a new option under Game Tab as shown below:

http://s19.postimg.org/xuiuje67n/Game_Menu_Themes.png 

Other release notes:

1. Fixed very minor issues in Level Designer, Game Launcher and game
2. Added a background to in-game Pause menu as sometimes the text might blend with the level and it would be hard to see options' text.

Other Updates:

1. WarZone level is almost complete and will be released this weekend.

And as always we left a branch for older builds incase if you need to revert 
back.

Thanks

notes.notes:

notes.title: Update v.04 is live introducing more features
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We have pushed an update with the following release notes:

1. Introducing Challenge mode option under Game Options, in this mode, enemies and bosses health will be doubled, enemies' and bosses' weapons damages will be doubled as well, you will start with 5 lives regardless of lives count set in level designer for all levels and you will no longer be awarded a new life when reaching score threshold. Ignore lives/hit effect options will be ignored and will always be active in challenge mode.

2. Now Enemies/Bosses Health will be doubled when playing in two players mode, note if challenge mode is set to "Yes" and playing in Two Players mode then enemies/bosses health will be quadrupled. 

3. Revamped Game Launcher UI and settings retrieval which allows us to add more options easily in the future.

4. Introducing Custom Start Position for Enemies/Bosses in Level Designer, previously you only had TopRight, MiddleRight and BottomRight start positions, now a new option is added called custom that allows you to drag enemy/boss objects vertically to set a custom spawn point through the newly added "Custom Start Position" form.

5. Updated UserManual to reflect the new features and changes.

And as always, we created a new branch for this build, you can always revert back to older builds.

Thanks

notes.title: Introducing Your Own Music Playlist with Update v.03 and Screenshots from next levels
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

A new update has been just released introducing music playlist, you no longer need level designer to change level's music, you can now use music play list feature by simply copying your music files to "[Game Installation Folder]\Music" folder.

The game engine will switch mode to PlayList mode and will play the music files in a play list one after another in loop mode, to switch between tracks use F1/F2 keys anytime, where F1 to select previous track and F2 to select next track. 

Note, only mp3, ogg and wav files are supported and maximum file size is 10 MB, files exceeding 10 MB in size will be skipped. 

your music will start playing at the very first menu in game and will continue playing in loop mode, restarting levels, playing next levels, bosses,... will not affect the currently played music.

on another note, Screen shots from WarZone and Cemetery levels that will be coming very soon, stay tuned.

WarZone:

http://s19.postimg.org/j9h1t6sj7/war_Zone.jpg
http://s19.postimg.org/4stsem31v/War_Zone2.jpg

Cemetery:

http://s19.postimg.org/n4kfvrboz/cemetery.jpg

Thanks

notes.title: Beta Update v.02 has been released
notes.notes:
Hello All,

Today we pushed an update v.02 which fixes the following minor issues:

1. Fixed Mouse Navigation through Menus' items as the selection range for each item was too wide.

2. Fixed Desert Boss dying Animation getting hidden when killed.

3. Fixed Boss Health Bar being misaligned while spawning.

P.S: We left a branch for v0.01 if you want to revert back to that build.

Thanks
